info.title: Health Watchers API
info.description: HIPAA-compliant healthcare management platform API with Stellar blockchain payment integration.

apiKeyBearer.description: Clinic API key (`hw_…`) with SMART-style scopes: `patient/*.read` or `patient/<Type>.read`. `Authorization: ApiKey hw_…` is also accepted.

V2Patient.description: Patient in the v2 list. With `fields`, only the requested properties are present.

Error.description: Standard error response returned by all controllers.

requestId.description: Correlation id for the request, when available.

ValidationError.description: Returned when request input fails validation (HTTP 400).

RateLimitError.description: Returned when a client exceeds its rate limit (HTTP 429).

NotFoundError.description: Returned when the requested resource does not exist (HTTP 404).

sourceAssetCode.description: Optional: source asset code chosen by payer (e.g., XLM)

sourceAssetIssuer.description: Optional: issuer for the source asset when non-native

destinationAmount.description: Destination amount clinic should receive (string decimal)

path.description: Optional Stellar path array to use for the payment

PaginationMeta.description: Standard pagination metadata returned by every list endpoint.

total.description: Total number of records matching the query.

limit.description: Maximum number of records per page.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page (cursor-based pagination only).

PaginatedResponse.description: Standard envelope for all paginated list endpoints.

scanStatus.description: Result of the virus scan performed before storage.

url.description: Time-limited signed URL for downloading the attachment.

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the signed URL expires.

LimitParam.name: limit
LimitParam.description: Maximum number of records per page.

SortParam.name: sort
SortParam.description: Field to sort by, optionally prefixed with `-` for descending order (e.g. `-createdAt`).

get.summary: List patients (v2) — cursor pagination and sparse fieldsets
get.description: Successor of `GET /api/v1/patients`, which now returns `Deprecation`, `Sunset` and `Link: </api/v2/patients>; rel="successor-version"` headers. Results are ordered newest first. Follow `links.next` (or pass `meta.nextCursor` as `cursor`) to fetch the next page; every page costs one index seek, so deep pages are as fast as the first.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated sparse fieldset, e.g. `id,firstName,lastName`. Unknown fields return 400.

post.description: Creates a pending payment record and returns the intent ID and memo for the Stellar transaction. Supports the `Idempotency-Key` header: retries with the same key return the original response for 24 hours instead of creating a duplicate intent.

get.summary: Get a signed download URL for an encounter attachment

post.summary: Receive an inbound webhook from an external system
post.description: Accepts events from external providers (e.g. Stellar payment events). Every request must carry a valid `X-Webhook-Signature` header computed with the receiver's webhook signing secret. Signing secrets can be rotated: during a rotation window both the previous and the current secret are accepted, after which the previous secret is revoked.

401.description: Signature missing, malformed, expired, or invalid

get.description: Cursor-based pagination over the audit log, ordered by `createdAt` descending then `_id` descending. Pass `after` to page forward or `before` to page backward; both cursors are opaque and are returned as `nextCursor` / `prevCursor` in the response.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Opaque forward cursor — return entries older than this cursor.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Opaque backward cursor — return entries newer than this cursor.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only entries created at or after this timestamp.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Only entries created at or before this timestamp.

200.description: A page of audit log entries

nextCursor.description: Pass as `after` to fetch the next (older) page.

prevCursor.description: Pass as `before` to fetch the previous (newer) page.

400.description: Invalid query parameters or malformed cursor

tags.name: Payments
tags.description: Stellar payment intents. Creation endpoints accept an `Idempotency-Key` header; retries with the same key return the cached response for 24 hours.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Inbound webhooks from external systems. Requests must be signed with HMAC-SHA256 and carry the signature in `X-Webhook-Signature`.

tags.name: Audit
tags.description: Audit log access with cursor-based pagination.
